requirements.title: AWS Cloud Security Engineer- Go Digit
Full Stack Developer (Tech Lead)- Freedom with Ai

kpis.title: Trello-based Day Planning
kpis.description: Every VAYUZer is expected to plan their day with clarity and discipline using Trello. This practice is a key attribute under our Plan Well value.
kpis.whyItMatters: Ensures transparency, better task tracking, and organized execution of People Group responsibilities

kpis.title: Speed of Profile Submission (Fresh Sourcing)
kpis.description: Share ≥ 5 relevant candidate profiles within 2 hours of receiving a new requirement from the Hiring Manager / Business Team.

kpis.title: Speed of Profile Submission (Post 1st Batch)
kpis.description: Share ≥ 5 relevant candidate profiles within 2 hours of receiving clarity from the end client on 1st batch submission.

kpis.title: Total Profiles Shared
kpis.description: Daily submission of quality candidate profiles for assigned requirements.

kpis.title: Shortlisting Ratio by Hiring Manager or The Client
kpis.description: Shortlisting Ratio = (Profiles Shortlisted by The Client / Profiles Shared by People Consultant) × 100

kpis.title: Onboarding Ratio
kpis.description: Onboarding Ratio = (# Onboarded / Profiles Shared by People Consultant) × 100

kpis.title: Minimum Onboarding per Month
kpis.description: Drive the hiring process end-to-end to ensure at least 2 successful candidate onboardings per month.
kpis.whyItMatters: Ensures shared ownership and balanced contribution.

kpis.title: Hiring Display Information System (HDIS) Updates
kpis.target: 100% adherence to daily updates in HDIS (no pending/backlog entries)
kpis.description: Maintain complete and accurate daily updates in the Hiring Display Information System for all assigned requirements, candidates, and hiring stages.
kpis.whyItMatters: Drives accountability and sharpens closure strategy.

kpis.title: Pariksha – Knowledge & Competency Assessment Score
kpis.description: Ensure participation in the monthly Pariksha conducted by the Line Manager to assess domain knowledge, recruitment process understanding, sourcing strategies, and tool competency.
kpis.whyItMatters: Promotes continuous learning and keeps the team updated with domain knowledge

kpis.title: Attendance & Timeliness
kpis.description: Maintain consistent attendance and punctuality as per VAYUZ's working schedule. - Minimum 95% monthly attendance (excluding approved leaves). - Zero cases of unplanned absenteeism without prior intimation. - Punctual login/start of work adherence (95%+ compliance)

kpis.title: Knowledge Contribution
kpis.description: Contribute actively to the Knowledge Base Repository of VAYUZ by creating and sharing high-quality insights, case studies, white papers, or thought-leadership content on digital assets of VAYUZ (Website, VAYUZ Social).
kpis.whyItMatters: Encourages innovation, thought leadership, and contribution beyond daily responsibilities

kpis.title: Event Ownership & SOP Development
kpis.description: - 100% documentation & SOP submission (covering objectives, flow, responsibilities, budget, challenges, learnings, feedback). - Event Satisfaction Score ≥ 80% (measured via VAYUZ Social).
kpis.whyItMatters: Builds a culture of creativity, communication, and motivation among employees

kpis.title: Process Adherence & Delivery Discipline (Flags & Notices System)
kpis.description: Adhere to all defined processes, delivery commitments, and quality benchmarks set at VAYUZ. Ensure zero escalation through Yellow Flags, Red Flags, or Red Notices by demonstrating discipline, accountability, and alignment with VAYUZ values.
kpis.whyItMatters: Builds discipline, accountability, and trust while ensuring smooth delivery and zero escalations.

kpis.title: Team Target Achievement
kpis.description: Drive, monitor, and ensure that all team members achieve their defined daily targets (maintaining minimum team strength, profiles shared, shortlisting ratio, HDIS updates, attendance, etc.).
kpis.whyItMatters: Strengthens the People Group through fresh talent, creating balance between experience and learning.

kpis.title: Interviews per Day
kpis.description: Every PPG consultant lines up and runs at least 4 candidate interviews each working day, logged in the Interviews section.
kpis.whyItMatters: A steady daily interview volume is the single biggest lever on pipeline health — it directly drives shortlists, offers, and closures.

kpis.title: Closure Target
kpis.description: Org-wide RADC + RADF closures (Fulfilled/Closed/onboarded) expected within the selected Dhruva reporting period.
kpis.whyItMatters: Closures are the ultimate measure of delivery output — tracking them against a target keeps the whole team focused on getting requirements to placement, not just moving them through the pipeline.
